scope: A separately identified Gaussian luminosity-prior target obtained by exact SN density ratios from an already qualified native-corrected modern source; no new physical age correction.
unchanged_factors: CMB, BAO, cosmological and calibration priors, released sample and its covariance, foreground calibration conventions and free global magnitude. Only the integrated smooth SN luminosity prior changes.
weight_rule: Untrimmed logweight_target = original exact/proposal logweight + normalized logL_SN_target - normalized logL_SN_source. No PSIS smoothing/clipping, no invented target chain or exact-correction manifest.
qualification: Require measurement_summary.summarize_run, at least2000 finite native points, and every frozen luminosity-sensitivity-design weight/chain/batch gate for the new target. A failed bridge is retained and cannot qualify. Finite diagnostics cannot establish unseen mode coverage.
